name: JV_OWNER_PERCENT_LINES
description: This table contains the stakeholders and their percentage of interest for a joint venture’s ownership percentage.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the ownership percentage line that defines each stakeholder's share of the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: OWNERSHIP_PERCENTAGE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the ownership percentage.

columns.name: STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture stakeholder that is associated with the ownership percentage line.

columns.name: PERCENTAGE_OF_INTEREST
columns.description: The percent of ownership a stakeholder has in a joint venture transaction.

columns.name: ROUNDING_PARTNER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the joint venture stakeholder is the rounding partner, receiving any extra cost or revenue after the split. Only one stakeholder in the ownership percentage can be the rounding partner.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the joint venture stakeholder is only participating in the transaction distribution and not being invoiced.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
